limits: Matched per-exchange local monotonic durations; independent A/B wall timestamps are not subtracted.
Trace durations are Go trace-clock measurements, not hardware network timestamps.
No continuous ping ran during physical crossings; tracing can perturb execution.
Uncontrolled trials with different sample counts cannot prove causality or a fixed latency bound.
Source roles describe A-to-B entries; B-to-A natural returns use A source deactivation.
The historical g546 325ms outlier had no matching execution trace and remains unclassified.
Nested startup/native validation spans can include earlier prewarming; do not add them or assume all occur on the current grant path.

worstGrant.intervalDifferenceMeaning: Residual of two causal local durations; includes transport, OS delivery and unmeasured intervals; not pure network RTT.

slowGrantReader.note: Contains intentional idle before the source request. Do not interpret the full 1.5s read as grant or network latency. The final grant precedes the last matching return in the retained trace.
